assertions.rule: hour_slots contains exactly one entry for every integer utc_hour from 0 through 23
hour_slots[utc_hour] explicitly selects the production_id and edition_id for that UTC hour; the mapping is authored per slot and must not be inferred from modulo arithmetic

basis: 24 distinct utc_hour values are explicitly present, one per UTC hour
Each hour slot has a distinct edition_id and an explicit production_id; selection uses hour_slots[utc_hour], not modulo arithmetic
UTC hour 21 maps to wordless-room-game-21 and wordless-room-game
Global constraints explicitly prohibit autoplay, private source material, payment logic, and unverified deployment claims
Activation boundary states runtime integration was not performed
limits: No application bundle was built in the original contract-recording run.
No Vercel deployment was attempted in the original contract-recording run.
No physical iPhone Safari audibility claim is made.

rollback: Revert this operations-only contract commit and the repertory contract commit; no application runtime rollback is required.
